text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They've turned into the final straight!! 
What will happen from here on out?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (—I'm going to be the one!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: To the veryyyy peak of dirrrrt!!!

She broke clear, she broke clear!! Hokko 
Tarumae has broken through!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And they cross the finish line!! The one 
who has claimed the new throne is Hokko 
Tarumae!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa...! She pulled off a magnificent 
win against this lineup...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: A new dirt heroine has been born...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. I knew it. Tarumae is going to be 
the key to my future...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the gap between our abilities is 
just way too big right now... When will I 
be ready? The JBC Classic... no, even 
further down the line—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Let's set our sights on "that." 
If we set it as our goal ahead of time, 
I'm sure we'll make it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae...! Acute-san...! I'll definitely 
make it there, so just wait for me...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: We did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I won...! Proudly and fairly... in this 
Teio Sho...!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations, Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That run really got my fire burning, it 
was incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! You were amazing 
too... Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...The 'JBC Classic.' That's where I'm 
planning to race next. If you're entering 
too, Tarumae-chan—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Let me get my revenge...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Leave bringing the Red Ogre... Falco-san 
here to me, Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Bring it on...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Let's face each other again...! At the 
JBC Classic!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I got carried away and promised that, 
but I'm really running the JBC Classic 
next, right!?
choice_data_list: It's okay, I do intend to run

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank goodness.

The "historic record" meant to be 
presented to Smart Falcon in order to draw 
her out—

In aiming for 'Most GⅠ Wins in History,' 
which was one of them, the JBC Classic was 
also a race where she wanted to deliver 
results.

Wonder Acute will surely stand in our way 
there as an even fiercer rival than today. 
A fierce battle is inevitable...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —I was truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Winning today was great and all, of 
course... but hearing Acute-san say that 
to me—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That I was able to become Acute-san's 
rival...—

...To Hokko Tarumae, Wonder Acute had 
always been a great senior leading the 
way.

I used to be overwhelmed by her running, 
but now I can stand shoulder to shoulder 
and compete with her. That fact fills me 
with pride—

Setting her sights on the JBC Classic as 
her next battle, she steps up as the new 
Dirt Monarch...!
